build_plan.architecture: native aarch64 Linux; M2 not required for build
correctness_before_hardware: Native compile of changed block/bio.o and full Image/modules/Apple DTBs with no errors; preserve module/config and ELF alignment checks.

Runtime gated trial: exercise cache-hit, emptycache+slabsuccess withoutDIRECT_RECLAIM, slabfailure+nonreclaimNULL, reclaim/mempool fallback and bvec allocation/failure. Run same test instrumentation on both variants; no runtime PASS from application.
build_plan.pair_policy: Same exact builder/config/flags/environment and suffix for both variants; source patch is sole experimental variable. Separate output dirs and retain full command/config/tool receipts. No binary reproducibility claim from source comparison.
build_plan.physical_acceptance: NOT RUN; exact M2Air13 and M2Air15 separately require tested known-good recovery boot, physical16K boot, storage integrity under pressure, AGX/HYPRLAND, audio+speaker protection under I/O, suspend/resume and paired power/thermal/performance measurements.
prerequisites: Freeze immutable native builder image and complete installed package inventory/tool executable hashes before execution.
Use retained full baseline/candidate trees verified against every archive member; no code changes except selected8-line patch.
Keep actual embedded config and compare generated config; any change beyond known compiler/version probe metadata blocks build.
No install target, root, boot/services/sysctl changes or performance/hardware acceptance in this build.

Reviewed native builder receipt must attest enforced writable-output quota<=24GiB, pin all nine tool commands to their actual /usr/bin:/bin resolved executable bytes, and native wrapper executes make in a cleared environment.

config.role: exact embedded config; generated historical config not reproduced
